description: Create a one-time client access link (7 days) plus a short ready-to-paste message for SMS, WhatsApp, email or Slack. The client opens it to consent and save their LinkedIn login and authenticator key to BAMF Vault. BAMF never sends it: give the message to the agency owner to send. Replaces any unused earlier link. Agency owner/admin only; API keys need the client_access:link scope.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name.

name: bamf.create_client_access_link
